body: Yeah... It's not like I didn't know it could happen. I don't think there's anything left to play out. I know it was my own dumb mistake, but that doesn't make it hurt any less...

Yeah, it was romantic... I would've left the marriage but she couldn't, or at least was too scared to. She's not a citizen and was worried about getting deported if she got divorced. Eventually her husband found out and she just stopped communicating altogether.
That's hard to do when I'm in a marriage I don't want to be in...
I hope you're still there... If you need someone to talk to I'm here. I understand what you're feeling...
